commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: Coverage is underway with 0.17 kilometers of walking now officially on the record.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: Opening moments, and already several stair-related choices have been made without adult supervision.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: Still here. The concept of stopping has not been activated.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: Our analysts confirm this is exercise, despite strong evidence it is a personal grudge.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: You could spend your time living, or you could go do another rep of stairs, I guess.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: The fastest verified section is on the board. The replay desk is declining to call it a sprint.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: A burst of speed from a man who knows the staircase cannot leave.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: The stairs have seen him before. They appear unwilling to comment.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: The broadcast reaches its verified high point at 211 meters.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: The route is complete. Officials can confirm that continued walking is no longer required.
